PDF Interactive Isosurface Ray Tracing of Large Octree Volumes
ABSTRACT We present a technique for ray tracing isosurfaces of large compressed structured volumes. Data is first converted into a lossless-compression octree representation that occupies a fraction of the original memory footprint.
